visual.general_description: Five-panel figure of a bilateral condylar head fracture case: preoperative CT, VSP/CAD renders of patient-specific devices, photograph of two plates, postoperative panoramic radiograph and 3D CT.
visual.detailed_description: Bone-window coronal CT slice. The air-filled upper airway forms a dark vertical band in the centre; the sphenoid region is above it. Both mandibular rami descend on either side with the condylar regions at their upper ends. On the image-left side a rounded bone fragment lies apart from the upper end of the ramus; on the image-right side the upper end of the ramus has an irregular contour with small fragments. A small dark air pocket is visible in the soft tissue at the upper left. The letter a is printed at lower right. Two side-by-side renders on a white background. Each shows a cream-white ramus with an orange-tan condylar head portion at the top and a gray plate with round holes. In the left render a long curved gray plate with a row of round holes runs down the ramus from a wider upper part, and a straight green line crosses the condylar region diagonally. In the right render the plate has a wider upper part with about five holes and a narrow lower limb with a row of holes; a green line crosses the upper part and a red dotted rhomboid outline encloses the lower portion of the plate upper part where it meets the line. The letter b is printed at lower right. Two dark gray metal plates are arranged side by side as mirror-like shapes. Each has a broader upper part with about five round holes and a long narrow curved lower arm with a row of smaller holes. Small blue dots are visible near some holes and short engraved characters are present on the plates but are not legible. The letter c is printed at lower centre. Panoramic radiograph of the dentition and both jaws. Round radiopaque dots are arranged along the upper and lower dental arches. Two horizontal plates with screws lie across the lower anterior mandible. In the upper left corner of the image a long narrow metal plate with screws is visible near the temporomandibular region. Several teeth show bright restorations. The letter d is printed at lower right. Cream-colored three-dimensional surface rendering of a skull side and mandibular ramus on a dark background. A bright vertical metal plate with screws lies along the condylar region, and further small plates with rounded screw heads are visible lower at the mandibular angle area. The letter e is printed at lower right.

visual.detailed_description: Oblique cream-colored three-dimensional bone rendering of a mandibular ramus with teeth at the bottom. At the top the condylar head appears as a rounded structure with a small separate rounded piece beside the ramus end. The letter a is printed at lower right. Four renders on a white background in a two-by-two grid, each showing a cream-colored condyle and ramus with a dark gray plate. The plate has a cluster of round holes at the upper end, an oval window in the middle and a narrow lower limb. Two green cylinders lie beside the plate in each view, seen from different angles. The letter b is printed at lower right. White mandible model with both rami rising from the body, photographed on a blue background. A small metallic plate with round holes and an oval window is attached at the condylar region of one ramus. The letter c is printed at lower right. Operative field with red tissue and retractors at the sides. A metal plate with an oval window and about six screws lies against pale bone in the centre. The letter d is printed at lower right. Operative field with two retractors, a forceps-like instrument at the right and a small round metal screw head visible at the exposed bone edge in the centre. The letter e is printed at lower right. Cream and orange-brown three-dimensional rendering of a skull side. A bright elongated metal structure descends from a rounded condylar head region, and a black round area lies to its right. The letter f is printed at lower right. Grayscale axial CT slice showing the nasal cavity, maxillary sinuses and skull base. On the image-left side bright metal hardware lies against a rounded bone structure near the mandibular condyle; on the opposite side the condyle appears as a ring-like structure without bright hardware. The letter g is printed at lower right, rotated. Panoramic radiograph showing the mandible and teeth. Bright metal restorations lie over upper and lower posterior teeth, and a thin line runs across the lower anterior teeth. The letter h is printed at lower right. No panel h is described in the caption.

A gray plate with scalloped finger-like projections and large oval windows encloses a yellow dome fragment and a cyan fragment at the top; below it a gray plate portion with round holes extends along the neck, and two tan cylindrical drill-guide shapes reach toward a magenta structure at the left.
